call_points.text: Standalone cash use planned at ₹600 Cr in FY27 and ₹500 Cr in FY28; free cash flow positive only in FY29.
Ethnic business FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 560 bps to 10.8% on lower TCNS losses.
TCNS cash breakeven expected towards end-FY27, full-year profitability from FY28; Tasva profitability still FY28.
Management declined to give FY27 revenue or segment profitability numbers, citing the long-term plan range.
Lease liability rose from ₹3,600 Cr to ₹4,500 Cr; CFO said no change in accounting.

operating_notes.text: CRISIL reaffirmed CRISIL AA+/Stable for long-term and CRISIL A1+ for short-term on ₹873 Cr bank loan facilities, ₹500 Cr CP, and ₹350 Cr NCDs.
CRISIL withdrew ratings on ₹1,967 Cr bank loan facilities at the company's request.
Indivinity Clothing Retail Private Limited (Tasva) recorded turnover of ₹144.24 Cr in FY25, ₹100.06 Cr in FY24, and ₹49.29 Cr in FY23.
Madura Fashion & Lifestyle demerger scheme became effective May 1, 2025.
Added 180+ gross stores in FY26, taking total retail footprint to over 7.9 Mn sq.ft. across 1,273 stores.
Pantaloons store count 399, OWND 79, Jaypore 44 as of Q4FY26.
TCNS full-year cash losses halved vs previous year, with ~7% LTL growth in Q4.
Pantaloons Q4FY26 L2L growth 14%; November-March L2L about 7% and total growth 9% after normalising EOSS shift.
TMRW run rate about ₹1,500 Cr with annual losses close to ₹200 Cr; FY29 profitability target.
Retail network 1,273 stores and almost 7.9 million sq ft as of March 2026, with 0.6 million sq ft added net in FY26.
TMRW increased its stake in Bewakoof Brands Private Limited to 99.03%.

timeline.summary: CRISIL reaffirmed credit ratings on ₹873 Cr bank facilities, ₹500 Cr CP, and ₹350 Cr NCDs at AA+/Stable and A1+, and withdrew ratings on ₹1,967 Cr bank lines.
Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited’s Board of Directors meeting scheduled for May 25, 2026, to approve Q4 and FY26 audited standalone and consolidated financial results.
ABFRL acquired additional shares in subsidiary Indivinity Clothing Retail for ₹175 Cr via rights issue, raising stake to 89.29%.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,990.13 Cr (+15.7% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹148.4 Cr (against a loss of ₹16.87 Cr a year earlier).
ABFRL published its Q4FY26 press release reporting consolidated revenue of ₹1,990 Cr (+16% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹311 Cr (+57% YoY).
ABFRL's Q4FY26 call (May 26, 2026) guided FY27 consolidated capex at ₹250-300 Cr, kept free cash flow positive at FY29 and Pantaloons FY27 additions at 20-22 stores.
Birla Group Holdings Private Limited declared no new encumbrances by promoters or PAC on Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited as of March 31, 2026.
On June 8, 2026, ABFRL announced that its subsidiary TMRW increased its stake in Bewakoof Brands by 10.02% to 99.03%.
Earnings Conference Call scheduled for Friday, November 6, 2026 at 16:00 HRS (IST).
